name: rosettes
title: Rosette Morphology
subtitle: Per-rosette area and shape from overhead images
description: Segments individual rosettes and measures area, perimeter, circularity, Feret diameter and compactness. One row per rosette.
method: CIE L*a*b* conversion (Lab Stack); foliage is separated on the a* channel, where green sits at negative a*. This is far more stable than an RGB threshold under the colour casts of LED growth lighting. Otsu threshold, despeckle, fill holes, watershed to split rosettes touching at the leaf margins.
dataType: overhead rosette images (Arabidopsis, lettuce, brassica seedlings)

outputs.name: Area
outputs.label: Rosette area
outputs.description: Projected leaf area of one rosette

outputs.name: Compactness
outputs.label: Compactness
outputs.description: Area / (pi/4 * Feret^2). 1.0 is a tight disc; lower means a spread, deeply lobed rosette.

notes: Structure term for the measured object: PO:0025615 (rosette).

commonColumns.Label: Source image title
commonColumns.Unit: Spatial unit of every length/area column
commonColumns.Calibrated: 1 if a scale was applied; 0 means all values are in pixels
